_about: The English of every menu text tr() looks up (emu/gba/pico_i18n.c), exactly as in the code. kind says where it is drawn; 'one' is the English for a count of 1 where the text changes with a count. Each <code>.json maps these to its language: a text, or for a count an object of the forms the language has (one, two, few, many, zero, other).
